#Fungi #Mushrooms #Nature

20 Most Bizarre Fungi on Earth You Won’t Believe Exist

There is a fungus that hijacks an insect's body, drives it like a puppet, and erupts from its skull. Another bleeds real red droplets. One glows green in the dark, and a hidden giant in Oregon is older than the pyramids. Fungi are neither plant nor animal — and science has named only a fraction of the millions out there.

In this nature documentary we count down the 20 strangest fungi on Earth — from the zombie-ant fungus and the bleeding tooth fungus to glowing bioluminescent mushrooms, the blue mushroom on New Zealand's banknote, and the "humongous fungus," the largest living organism on the planet.
